title: Head of Sales - LATAM
description:
Who We Are

At MonetizeMore, we use AI and data to revolutionize how the advertising industry combats Invalid Traffic (IVT) and fraud. Our flagship product, Traffic Cop, is a premium solution designed to protect ad-monetized publishers and ad tech vendors from fraudulent activity. For over 15 years, our fully remote team of 100+ professionals has been driven by four core pillars: Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen. We are culture-centric, results-driven, and obsessed with building impactful, data-powered solutions.

What It’s Like Working Here

  • Actions > Talk: Execution is everything.
  • Slack & Async First: Clear, async communication is our lifeline.
  • Challenge Everything: “Why not?” is a welcome mindset.
  • Data > Ego: Bring your bold ideas—and the numbers to back them up.
  • No Titles, Just Results: Respect is earned, not granted.
  • Fail Fast, Learn Faster: Mistakes are data. We improve from them.
  • Follow Through: We do what we say—big or small.

Your Role: Head of Sales

As our Head of Sales, you’ll be responsible for defining, leading, and executing MonetizeMore’s global sales strategy. This is a high-impact leadership role for a strategic, hands-on sales expert who can build and scale a revenue engine across international markets, with a focus on high-value enterprise clients in the ad-tech space.

What You’ll Do

  • Own & Lead the Sales Function: Drive the entire sales cycle from strategy to execution—from lead generation to contract close.
  • Set the Sales Vision: Define and execute MonetizeMore’s go-to-market strategy in collaboration with the Executive Team.
  • Drive Strategic Revenue: Target and close deals with Publishers, have existing relationships, and understand needs of DSPs, SSPs, GCPPs, MCMs, and exchanges to drive partner-led sales for Traffic Cop across LATAM.
  • Build & Scale the Sales Team: Hire, coach, and manage high-performing sales talent, building a metrics-driven sales org.
  • Act as a Player-Coach: Stay hands-on in high-stakes sales conversations and negotiations while coaching others to success.
  • Present & Educate: Deliver compelling product pitches and demos tailored to client challenges and verticals.
  • Refine the Value Proposition: Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen our messaging and positioning in a competitive market.
  • Optimize Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and hit aggressive growth targets.
  • Establish Strategic Partnerships: Identify and onboard channel partners to amplify our reach and strengthen joint go-to-market efforts.
  • Inform Product & GTM Strategy: Relay market intelligence and customer feedback to help shape our product roadmap and growth initiatives.
  • Sell with AI in Mind: Understand and articulate how Traffic Cop solves complex fraud and IVT issues in digital advertising—positioning its technological edge as a major differentiator in the market.

Who You Are

  • Proven Sales Leader: 7–10 years of experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or ad-tech sales, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership role.
  • AI Fluent: You understand the fundamentals of AI and machine learning as they apply to digital advertising, fraud detection, or cybersecurity. You’re able to translate technical concepts into clear business value for enterprise clients.
  • Ad-Tech Fluent: Deep understanding of the ad-tech ecosystem—including publishers, DSPs, SSPs, and exchanges.
  • Strategic & Analytical: You use data to inform decisions and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Clear, persuasive, and confident in high-level discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Global Operator: Experience working across multiple time zones and regions, especially LATAM.
  • Self-Motivated & Results-Oriented: You take initiative, thrive in ambiguity, and are relentless in pursuit of your goals.
  • Builder & Innovator: Comfortable in startup or scale-up environments with a mindset for continuous improvement.

Why Join Us

  • 100% remote with flexible work hour
  • Work with a highly driven, globally distributed team
  • Be part of a fast-growing company solving meaningful problems in the ad-tech industry
  • Opportunity to shape the sales function and leadership path in a mission-driven, data-powered company

description:
Overview

Chief Financial Officer, Trilogy (Remote) - $400,000/year USD. This role is a full-time, remote position with compensation at $200/hour (approximately $400,000/year for a 40-hour week, 50 weeks/year).

This role is for a visionary finance leader who will architect an AI-powered financial ecosystem to support Trilogy’s growth in K-12 education and EdTech platforms. You will design financial systems that scale with the company’s ambitious trajectory and drive overall financial strategy beyond traditional CFO playbooks.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Pioneer an AI-first financial architecture that sets new standards in educational business operations
  • Craft strategic design decisions to transform complex financial workflows into scalable solutions
  • Shape the future of finance operations through executive guidance that elevates AI systems and human teams
  • Drive critical decisions in strategic planning sessions focused on growth, vendor partnerships, and compliance excellence
  • Orchestrate seamless financial operations across tuition management, audits, and tax compliance at unprecedented scale

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Overseeing a traditional, large-scale finance department
  • Getting bogged down in routine monthly closing procedures or transaction approvals
  • Settling for off-the-shelf ERP solutions
  • Operating from the sidelines—you will be hands-on in the transformation
  • Managing steady-state operations in a high-growth, high-innovation environment

Chief Financial Officer Key Responsibilities

Design, implement, and oversee a cutting-edge AI-powered financial ecosystem that drives multiple education ventures to new heights, emphasizing efficiency, scalability, and zero redundancy.

Basic Requirements

  • Professional certification (CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CFA, or MBA)
  • A decade-plus trajectory of progressive finance leadership experience
  • Proven track record in C-suite or senior finance positions with comprehensive financial oversight
  • Mastery of US GAAP and financial statement integration
  • Extensive ERP system expertise, particularly in complex organizational structures
  • Substantial Big 4 audit experience (minimum 5 audits, either side of the table)
  • Superior communication capabilities in English, ready for executive-level discourse
  • Geographic alignment within UTC-8 to UTC+3 zones

Nice-to-have Requirements

  • Deep understanding of U.S. K-12 education landscape, including private, charter, and ESA programs
  • Track record in developing AI-enhanced financial automation systems
  • Proven success navigating multi-entity, cross-jurisdictional financial operations

About Trilogy

Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. Trilogy has focused for three decades on talent, technology, and incubating new businesses. The company emphasizes simple customer-facing designs and cloud-based innovation. Trilogy is a place to grow your career and work with great people.

Working with us

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The role requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. Tester de Software (QA) / Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento na BairesDev

Buscamos excelentes Tester de Software (QA) para se juntarem à equipe de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D) da BairesDev. Nossa equipe de P&D é uma parte essencial de nossas soluções de tecnologia que geram milhões em receita todos os anos, portanto, contratamos apenas os melhores entre os melhores.

Dentro da equipe, você encontrará muitos desafios diferentes: análise de dados, machine learning, desktop e desenvolvimentos da web são alguns dos mais relevantes no momento, mas você perceberá que coisas novas surgem todos os dias para impulsionar a inovação, A área de P&D é sem dúvida a área mais interessante e desafiadora de toda a empresa, e embora a BairesDev seja formada por pessoas realmente talentosas, aqui você encontrará profissionais com vasta experiência e também de nível intelectual e criativo, muito acima da média.

Queremos gente que curta o desafio! Você está pronto?

Responsabilidades

- Analisar os requisitos do usuário final para definir e documentar os planos de teste.

- Executar casos de teste, depurar, detectar erros e / ou possíveis melhorias, documentar e fazer o acompanhamento para serem resolvidos.

- Gerar relatórios de resultados de testes e dos erros detectados.

- Definir prioridades e planejar testes de requisitos de sistema.

- Documentar as funcionalidades dos sistemas.

- Representar o usuário final para os desenvolvedores para garantir que os requisitos sejam atendidos.

- Detectar e propor melhorias tanto no processo de controle de qualidade quanto no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.

Esperamos que você tenha:

- 4+ anos de experiência em testes de Produtos Web.

- Sólidos conhecimentos em ferramentas de teste.

- Desenvolvimento de planos de teste: criação de casos de teste e depuração.

- Conhecimento adicional em tecnologias web.

- Amplo conhecimento em ambientes Unix e Linux.

- Nível avançado de inglês.

Como tornamos seu trabalho (e sua vida) mais fácil:

- Modalidade 100% remota - trabalhe de qualquer lugar.

- Excelente remuneração em USD ou na sua moeda local, como preferir.

- Hardware para você trabalhar de casa.

- Horários flexíveis - faça seu próprio horário.

- Licença parental remunerada, férias, e feriados nacionais.

- Ambiente de trabalho inovador e multicultural.

- Colabore e aprenda com o Top 1% global dos talentos de cada área.

- Ambiente de apoio com mentoria, promoções, desenvolvimento de habilidades, e diversas oportunidades de crescimento.

Junte-se a uma equipe global onde seus talentos excepcionais podem se destacar!

  • Specific knowledge of financial accounting for card transactions.

title: Especialista de Custos e Produtividade Campinas - SP Full-time employee
description:
Somos movidos pelo propósito de transformar vidas com a nossa energia levando mais conforto para as pessoas, mais eficiência para os negócios e desenvolvimento para as cidades.

Nossa força vem da promoção de uma cultura inclusiva, que compreende e valoriza a diversidade e que respeita as diferenças, para que todas as pessoas sejam as suas melhores versões.

As pessoas são o nosso maior valor!

Por aqui a segurança é um valor inegociável, cuidamos uns dos outros! Valorizamos a autonomia e a colaboração no dia a dia. Fazemos acontecer de maneira apaixonada, evoluindo sempre! Nossas pessoas querem ir longe e aqui encontram perspectiva para crescer.

Você busca por um desafio profissional que pode transformar o mundo? Então o seu lugar é na Comgás! Temos orgulho de fazer parte do futuro da energia do Brasil!

Quer evoluir com a gente?

️ Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Estruturar, analisar e controlar custos e produtividade de obras de infraestrutura e redes de gás natural.
  • Elaborar e revisar composições de custos unitários, orçamentos e cronogramas físico-financeiros.
  • Monitorar indicadores de produtividade por tipo de obra, extensão e material, propondo melhorias com base em benchmarks e dados históricos.
  • Realizar análises de viabilidade econômica e simulações de cenários para apoiar decisões estratégicas.
  • Apoiar negociações com fornecedores, avaliando propostas técnicas e comerciais, e contribuindo para cláusulas contratuais (glosas, retenções, reajustes).
  • Garantir conformidade com normas técnicas, regulatórias e contratuais do setor de gás e construção civil.
  • Participar da construção do planejamento estratégico da companhia, alinhando contratações e negociações ao plano de eficiência.
  • Desenvolver ferramentas de modelagem de custos (Cost Breakdown, ShouldCost, entre outras).
  • Gerar dados estratégicos por meio do acompanhamento das produtividades de campo.
  • Divulgar análises de mercado, contextualizando riscos e oportunidades no cenário macroeconômico.

Ensino Superior completo (Engenharia, Administração de Empresas, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas afins).

Pós graduação ou cursos de especialização.

Desejável: Inglês avançado

Conhecimento avançado em Excel, Word e PowerPoint, ERPs utilizados na área. (Desejável Conhecimentos em SAP ECC e SAP Ariba)

Disponibilidade de atuar em modelo híbrido em Campinas ( 3x no escritório por semana)

Cuidar da saúde é essencial, não é?

Por isso, além do vale-refeição e para a comida gostosa do dia a dia, oferecemos assistência médica, odontológica, auxílio farmácia, auxílio óptico e seguro de vida. Nosso Programa Equilíbrio inclui, por exemplo, ações para promover a saúde física, mental, social e financeira. E nada melhor que manter o corpo em dia com Gympass, e cuidar da mente, com o Programa Amigo, para apoio psicológico.

Como empresa cidadã, temos licença maternidade estendida (180 dias) e paternidade (20 dias), para filhos(as) biológicos(as) ou adotivos(as). É mamãe? Então também temos auxílio-creche, auxílio material escolar e sala de lactação no nosso Centro Operacional.

Além disso, a saúde financeira também precisa estar em dia. Temos participação nos lucros e previdência privada, além de boas oportunidades de crescimento, com incentivo à educação.

A gente te espera, para crescer junto da gente!

Energia para nós é muito mais do que fornecer gás natural encanado para os nossos clientes. É unir forças para impulsionar pessoas, empresas, um país inteiro em direção a um futuro melhor.

Estamos sempre em busca do melhor, da próxima descoberta, de uma nova fronteira. Antecipamos o que importa para os nossos clientes, para o nosso negócio.

Executamos com excelência para subir o padrão de segurança e tecnologia de todo o setor. E a força do nosso time nos traz um dia a dia repleto de oportunidades, desafios e inovação.

É assim que atendemos aos mais de 2 milhões de clientes. Com a nossa energia, transformamos vidas levando mais conforto para as pessoas, mais eficiência para os negócios e desenvolvimento para as cidades dentro da nossa área de concessão.

Temos três avenidas de crescimento que nos guiam até a Comgás do Futuro, cujos principais habilitadores são a segurança das nossas operações e a agenda ESG:

- Pessoas no Centro, pois nossas ações partem de pessoas para pessoas

- Eficiência nas Jornadas, entregando o nosso melhor fazendo uso consciente dos recursos disponíveis

title: Placement Matching Specialist (Fully Remote)
description:
About Virtual Internships

We’re on a mission to create a world where internships are guaranteed for all. We ensure learners have access to remote internship opportunities at innovative companies worldwide, regardless of their background, major, location, or career field choice. Our clients include universities, governments, foundations, and online education institutions.

  • $14.3million Series A fundraise announced in September 2022, with investors including Hambro Perks, Sequoia India & Surge, Arsenal Growth, Kaplan, and Ascend Vietnam Ventures
  • Ranked 20th out of 13,000 organizations to “Escape To in 2023”Featured as a Top 100 EdTech Startup by HolonIQ in 2021, 2022, and 2023
  • Rated as a Top 50 Rising Startup by Tech in Asia in 2022
  • Remote-first with 100+ employees across 20+ countries globally
  • B2B EdTech product, trusted by 100+ universities, 10,000+ interns, and 14,000+ companies

One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to “try before you apply” by visiting our VI-P Guide , which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are!

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role , with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “moo ”—you’ll need it later!)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact: You’ll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities: Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking: Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth: Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

We’re looking for a powerful mix of The Self-Starter , The Persuader , and The Global Citizen — rolled into one Placement Matching Specialist. Here’s how you’ll know you’re the right fit:

  • You own the outcome: You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame. (The Driver )
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10. (The Learner )
  • You close the loop: You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact. (The Finisher )
  • You stay cool under pressure: Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have:

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
  • Cultural awareness and adaptability, especially if you’ve studied, lived, or worked abroad.
  • Proven ability to hustle, meet targets, and deliver results under pressure.

We’re also keen to hear from career switchers with strong written persuasion skills . Whether you’ve honed these in teaching , customer service , or another fast-paced role, if you:

  • Have a knack for crafting compelling messages
  • Can influence others through your writing
  • Are ready to bring your drive and adaptability into a new challenge

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote-First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave : Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.
  • Flexible VIer Budget: You’ll receive a flexible budget of $1,000 per year that you can use on but not limited to your work setup, personal wellness, or professional development.
  • Tech: New joiners receive a budget for your company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

description:
Inclusão e respeito à diversidade e equidade fazem parte do DNA da KPMG.

Aqui valorizamos todas as pessoas, encorajando e empoderando os nossos profissionais para que se sintam parte das nossas conquistas.

Independente da sua idade, gênero, raça, cor, credo, orientação, sexual, etnia, origem nacional ou deficiência, te convidamos a fazer a diferença. Venha fazer parte do time KPMG!

Vaga destinada à KPMG Auditores Independentes LTDA.

A estrutura de Auditoria baseia-se nos princípios essenciais relacionados à integridade profissional, a independência e ao comportamento ético que todos os sócios e membros da equipe precisam apresentar.

A auditoriaé desenvolvida por um conjunto estabelecido de normas e tecnologias de supervisão, análise e consulta e por ferramentas que auxiliam as equipes a acessar conhecimentos – inclusive as técnicas de auditoria computadorizadas exclusivas da KPMG –, tudo projetado para ajudar as equipes a se concentrarem em questões que exercem impacto sobre as decisões de auditoria e para aprimorar sua efetividade e eficiência.

•Fazemos o que é certo #Integrity

•Aprendemos e nos aprimoramos #Excellence

•Pensamos e agimos de maneira arrojada #Courage

•Respeitamos uns aos outros e nos e nos fortalecemos com nossas diferenças #Together

•Fazemos o que realmente importa #For Better

Caso seja aprovado(a), você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Executar operações de auditoria externa em processos contábeis e controles internos;
  • Auditar os procedimentos envolvidos, identificando eventuais falhas e avaliando a eficácia dos controles;
  • Realizar validação de demonstrações financeiras e avaliação dos processos, verificando a correta aplicação das normas nos registros e nas demonstrações financeiras;
  • Apontar não conformidades, confecção de relatórios com pareceres e recomendações;
  • Formalizar os papeis de trabalho com qualidade e ceticismo;
  • Revisar os papeis de trabalho da equipe;
  • Ser responsável por orientar equipe no cumprimento da metodologia e minimização de riscos de auditoria.

O que procuramos em você?

  • Experiência com auditoria externa, preferencialmente em Big Four.
  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou Administração de Empresas.

Quais as vantagens de ser KPMG?

•Aqui atuamos com as mais novas tecnologias;

•Nossos profissionais são referência no mercado;

•Somos uma das maiores empresas de prestação de serviço do mundo;

Quais benefícios oferecemos?

•Vale Refeição

•Vale Alimentação

•Assistência Médica

•Assistência Odontológica

•Benefício Bem-estar (Academia)

•Seguro de Vida

•Auxílio Creche

•Incentivo a Graduação

•Subsídio de Órgão de Classe

•Brinde Casamento

•Brinde Nascimento

•Licença Maternidade Extendida

•Jornada de Trabalho Flexível

•Incentivo à Idiomas

A KPMG é uma organização global de firmas independentes que prestam serviços profissionais para empresas, governos, startups , agências do setor público, organizações sem fins lucrativos e instituições dos mercados de capitais.. Estamos presentes em 145 países e territórios, com mais de 236 mil sócios e profissionais atuando nas firmas-membro em todo o mundo. No Brasil, somos aproximadamente cinco mil sócios e profissionais. Cada firma-membro KPMG é uma entidade legal independente e separada e descreve-se como tal, sendo responsável jurídica e financeiramente por suas próprias obrigações e por seus próprios atos. Orientada pelo seu propósito de empoderar a mudança, a KPMG empresa é uma organização referência nos segmentos em que atua. Compartilhamos valor e inspiramos confiança no mercado de capitais e nas comunidades há mais de 100 anos, transformando pessoas e empresas e gerando impactos positivos, que contribuem para a realização de mudanças sustentáveis em nossos clientes, governos e sociedade civil.

Prestamos serviços profissionais, baseados em princípios éticos e de excelência, em três áreas:

Auditoria: Avaliamos e asseguramos as informações geradas por nossos clientes por meio de serviços de auditoria independente, com base em metodologias e tecnologias exclusivas. Dessa forma, contribuímos para a qualidade das informações nas tomadas de decisões.

Impostos: Ajudamos nossos clientes a cumprirem as demandas tributárias, assim como a se prepararem para responder às demandas de seus negócios, aplicando nosso conhecimento e nossa visão de longo prazo para auxiliá-los a tomar decisões que gerem valor aos seus negócios e à sociedade.

Consultoria: Apoiamos as decisões estratégicas e o desenvolvimento de projetos das empresas em planejamento estratégico, ESG, fusões e aquisições, gestão de riscos e compliance, melhoria das performances financeira e operacional, transformação dos negócios, inovação e tecnologia, por meio de abordagens multidisciplinares. Também atuamos como provedores de serviços gerenciados.

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

Job Summary
The Office of the CIO is seeking a Change Management Specialist to lead the planning and execution of change management strategies across high-impact initiatives in the technology portfolio in support of Program Management, Commercial Activities, and Supply Chain . This role is critical in ensuring the successful adoption of business and operational changes in our Program Management, Commercial Activities, and Supply Chain portfolios, with a strong focus on measurable outcomes and stakeholder engagement.
You will partner closely with project managers, agile teams, functional leaders, and executive sponsors to ensure that the people side of transformation is effectively addressed — driving adoption, minimizing resistance, and enabling sustainable results.

  • Develop and lead end-to-end change management strategies for technology projects related to program management, master data, customer engagement, sales, logistics, and supply chain.

  • 4+ years of experience in organizational change management in complex corporate environments, preferably supporting Program Management, Commercial Activities, or Supply Chain.

As the Cloud Partner Success Manager, you will leverage your experience in Account Management with a strong focus on Data Protection and Cyber Security. You will manage a portfolio of service providers using Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud in Brazil. Your primary objectives will include driving Annual Recurrent Revenue growth through strategic account planning, fostering adoption of new services, ensuring partner retention, and delivering a best-in-class partner experience that distinguishes Acronis in the market.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Conduct territory analysis and planning for dedicated geographies to identify top potential partners, develop relationship with key decision makers on partner side and maintain a regularity/frequency of contact with every partner depending on priority
  • Align with Acronis Cloud Distributors for joint activities for channel enablement and drive quarter over quarter cloud revenue growth working through assigned partners
  • Train new and existing partners with existing and new products, support new partners on daily basis on business and technology development, and guide them through onboarding and enablement stage equipping with all needed knowledge, resources and tools
  • Perform account planning with all managed partners with level of certain details depending on partner’s engagement, loyalty and responsiveness
  • Motivate and enable partners to sell Acronis services to existing customer base of the partner, attract new customers to partner and help to retain existing customer to partner
  • Drive partner’s satisfaction and acting as a trusted advisor and single point of contact throughout the entire partner lifecycle
  • Drive successful upsell/cross sell initiatives with partner to increase new services attach rate
  • Engage and orchestrate all needed internal resources to help dedicated partners’ growth, including Presales and Technical support teams
  • Profile every managed partner on vendors and tools they sell/use putting all information into Partner Passport. Every CSP Passport should have not less than 80% fields filled out
  • Know partner’s lifecycle management and be able to lead a partner along it through a set of regular activities focused on educating, evangelizing, making committed
  • Key KPIs: Total Revenue from signed partners, churn rate (% of partners leaving the program), number of Acronis services sold through the partner

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years of sales and marketing experience in the software industry (Inside Channel Sales and Channel development position within a software vendor)
  • Fluent English and Portuguese, both written and verbal
  • Proven experience in a cyber security company demonstrating a strong understanding of industry practices and protocols is required
  • In-depth channel and field sales experience with an understanding of the cloud market business model
  • Strong presentation, communication, and planning skills
  • Strong internal customer focus with desire to learn all aspects of the business
  • High level of discipline, attention to detail, and ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment while still maintaining a high-level of accuracy
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
  • Outstanding organizational, problem solving, and multi-tasking skills
  • Collaborative, team-player with a commitment to succeed and never give up attitude
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work with minimal supervision

WHO WE ARE

Acronis is a global cyber protection company that provides natively integrated cybersecurity, data protection, and endpoint management for managed service providers (MSPs), small and medium businesses (SMBs), enterprise IT departments and home users. Our all-in-one solutions are highly efficient and designed to identify, prevent, detect, respond, remediate, and recover from modern cyberthreats with minimal downtime, ensuring data integrity and business continuity. We offer the most comprehensive security solution on the market for MSPs with our unique ability to meet the needs of diverse and distributed IT environments.

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and more than 1800 employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 20,000 service providers to protect over 750,000 businesses.

Our corporate culture is focused on making a positive impact on the lives of each employee and the communities we serve. Mutual trust, respect and belief that we can contribute to the world everyday are the cornerstones of our team. Each member of our “A-Team” plays an instrumental role in driving the success of our innovative and expanding business. We seek individuals who excel in dynamic, global environments and have a never give up attitude, contributing to our collective growth and impact.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process.

Use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during live interviews may be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process and a full criminal, education and identification background check is required for all new hires.

Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe. Seu papel será liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento do nosso produto de gerenciamento de atendimento (Service Management), construído sobre nossa plataforma low-code. O desafio é guiar o time na criação de uma solução robusta e escalável, promovendo inovação e excelência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir o alinhamento técnico entre times e especialistas, assegurando coesão arquitetural e boas práticas.
  • Avaliar e apoiar decisões técnicas em frontend (Vue.js), backend (Node.js, Express), banco de dados (MySQL) e cloud (GCP), em conjunto com especialistas de cada área.
  • Definir e documentar diretrizes arquiteturais, priorizando escalabilidade, eficiência e segurança.
  • Mentorar o time de desenvolvimento, incentivando boas práticas e a troca de conhecimento entre áreas.
  • Atuar como ponte entre desenvolvimento, produto e design, alinhando soluções técnicas aos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Planejar, delegar e acompanhar atividades, equilibrando prazos e qualidade.

Principais desafios

  • Evoluir nosso UI Builder: Participar da evolução do construtor de componentes e páginas, que permite criar telas e fluxos completos utilizando recursos do Vue.js por meio de interface, com alguns cliques e poucas linhas de código. Nosso objetivo é trazer a experiência de codar para o UI Builder, permitindo que até páginas mais complexas possam ser construídas nele.
  • Desenvolver nossa solução white label: Contribuir para a evolução do motor de criação de plataformas white label, que oferece funcionalidades nativas como autenticação, gerenciamento de usuários, permissões, construtor de formulários, CRUD de tabelas SQL via interface, CSM, entre outras. Tudo isso em um ambiente isolado para cada cliente, com possibilidade de customizações específicas.
  • Aprimorar nosso marketplace de páginas: Criar e expandir o marketplace que permite a publicação, instalação e gestão de páginas desenvolvidas em Vue, compartilháveis entre diferentes clientes do nosso ecossistema.
  • Expandir nossa biblioteca de componentes: Desenvolver componentes únicos e reutilizáveis, como formulários dinâmicos, calendários, gráficos Gantt, listas com integração nativa a APIs etc.
  • Desenvolver soluções de IA e Machine Learning: Criar fluxos com LLMs, integrando funções acionáveis em contextos específicos (como consultas em banco de dados). Implementar RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) por meio de vetorização de dados, buscas por similaridade e integração com LLM.
  • Automatizar com fluxos low-code/no-code: Implementar soluções usando ferramentas como N8N e ActivePieces, construindo fluxos e APIs completas via interface. Também criar novos nós reutilizáveis por toda a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Contribuir para o open source: Apoiar a abertura dos nossos produtos para a comunidade, fomentando colaboração global e ampliando o impacto das soluções.

Informações adicionais

  • Contratação PJ.
  • Trabalho remoto, com encontros presenciais ocasionais em Recife (valorizamos esses momentos, mas não são uma exigência).
  • Horários flexíveis, com foco em resultados.

Por que trabalhar na Beyond?

  • Impacto positivo real: Nossos produtos transformam áreas como educação, saúde e direito.
  • Crescimento acelerado: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento por meio de cursos, workshops e eventos.
  • Equipe de alto nível: Ambiente colaborativo, com aprendizado constante.
  • Cultura inclusiva: Valorizamos diversidade, bem-estar e crescimento profissional.

Benefícios e bem-estar

Nós da BAUMINAS estamos em busca de um Analista de Segurança da Informação SENIOR para assumir a missão de garantir nossa proteção de dados nas avaliações, seleções e implementações de hardware, software e aplicativos.

Procuramos um analista de segurança da informação para atuar em um papel híbrido, unindo as atividades operacionais de Blue Team com as práticas estratégicas e regulatórias de Governança, Risco e Conformidade (GRC). O profissional será um elo essencial para assegurar a proteção cibernética e a conformidade regulatória da organização.

Se você é um profissional analítico, proativo e entendedor dos processos de SI, queremos te conhecer!!

Venha fazer parte de nosso time de TI!!


Main responsibilities

1. Segurança da Informação e Blue Team:

  • Monitorar, detectar, analisar e responder a incidentes de segurança.
  • Administrar e operar ferramentas de proteção, incluindo SIEM, EDR, antivírus, firewalls, IDS/IPS, servidores e endpoints.
  • Aplicar patches de segurança e configurações seguras em servidores, dispositivos e demais equipamentos.
  • Gerenciar e corrigir vulnerabilidades identificadas, garantindo mitigação adequada e priorização de riscos críticos.
  • Apoiar a equipe de tecnologia e desenvolvimento para garantir convergência entre requisitos comerciais, técnicos e de segurança.

2. Governança, Risco e Compliance (GRC):

  • Desenvolver, revisar e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de segurança alinhados com requisitos legais e regulatórios.
  • Identificar, analisar e avaliar riscos de segurança cibernética, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar riscos de fornecedores, incluindo auditoria de controles e acompanhamento de planos de ação.
  • Realizar análises de impacto ao negócio (BIA), planejamento de continuidade e recuperação de desastres.
  • Elaborar relatórios detalhados de análise de risco e resposta a incidentes.

3. Gestão de Indicadores e KPIs:

  • Apoiar, manter, monitorar e reportar KPIs e métricas do ambiente (tempo de detecção e resposta, vulnerabilidades críticas, incidentes por categoria, SLA de remediação, etc.).
  • Ter conhecimento na construção de dashboards gerenciais e relatórios estratégicos.
  • Analisar tendências e propor melhorias contínuas na postura de segurança.

4. Projetos e Melhoria Contínua:

  • Propor, participar e conduzir projetos corporativos relacionados à segurança da informação.
  • Implementar, alterar, testar controles e configurações de segurança da informação.
  • Garantir que processos internos e metodologias de segurança suportem os projetos da empresa.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e estratégica para áreas internas, oferecendo suporte em dúvidas e decisões sobre segurança.

5. Administração e Suporte Técnico:

  • Apoiar na administração de endpoints, firewalls, servidores e soluções Microsoft 365.
  • Apoiar na análise de risco e auditorias internas e externas.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico e estratégico às áreas de TI e negócios em temas relacionados à segurança da informação.

Experiências e Competências Desejadas:

  • Experiência mínima de 5 a 8 anos em segurança da informação, com foco em Blue Team, GRC e administração de sistemas corporativos.
  • Experiência prática em SIEM, EDR, firewalls, IDS/IPS, análise de logs, vulnerabilidades e incidentes.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks e normas como ISO 27001, NIST, COBIT, ITIL, LGPD/GDPR .
  • Experiência em análise de risco, auditoria, BIA, continuidade de negócios e recuperação de desastres.
  • Habilidade em administrar soluções Microsoft 365, endpoints e servidores.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar KPIs de segurança e construir dashboards gerenciais.
  • Forte comunicação para atuar com áreas técnicas e de negócio, conduzindo treinamentos e projetos estratégicos.
  • Proatividade, visão estratégica e experiência em projetos corporativos de segurança da informação.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo. Indispensável Pós na área de Segurança da Informação;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 a 7 anos na área de Segurança da Informação;
  • Experiencia em mapeamento de risco, análise de impacto e gestão de politicas de segurança;
  • Vivencia em norma ISO 27001 e 27002 e 27005;
  • Vivencia em framework NIST;
  • Conhecimento em ITIL e COBIT;
  • Conhecimento em análise e mitigação de riscos cibernéticos, incluindo gerenciamento de riscos de fornecedores;
  • Gerenciar riscos cibernéticos e apoiar nos planos de mitigações;
  • Conhecimento em LGPD tratativas administrativas e técnicas;
  • Certificações serão considerados um diferencial;
  • Inglês: Intermediário;

description:
Demand Generation Specialist (6 Month Contract in Brazil)

Remote - BRAZIL

FreeWill is an award-winning, social-good startup that has partnered with 2,200 + nonprofits who support our mission while generating $11.9B in gift commitments for nonprofits since we were founded in 2017. We’ve been featured in the New York Times, Forbes, Oprah’s magazine, and our co-CEOs have even been named to Town & Country’s “Top 50 Philanthropists” list.

All of this is because we’ve figured out how to make some powerful (but complicated!) ways to donate much easier and more accessible. Our products make things easier for the donors who want to change the world and for nonprofits doing heroic work around the planet.

Full-time • Contract • Work from Anywhere in Brazil

About the Role

We are looking for a Demand Generation Specialist to support our growing and dynamic marketing team and serve as an integral bridge to the customer-facing teams we partner with.

This role will work closely with our marketing, sales and partner success teams to concept, develop, implement, measure, and improve inbound and outbound marketing content, campaigns, events, and initiatives that generate qualified leads, educate prospects at all stages of the customer journey, and increase sales velocity.

**Please note that this role will be a 6-month Contract role with a potential of extension based on performance

The compensation for this role will be an hourly rate between $14.42 - $16.83 USD working 40 hours per week.

Responsibilities

  • Work cross-functionally with product marketing, sales and partner success to execute a variety of demand generation initiatives that help us target prospects and customers in all phases of the buying cycle.
  • Assist with trade shows and conferences, including planning, logistics, coordinating attendance with the sales team, overseeing lead capture and follow-up, and measuring event ROI.
  • Support our regular marketing events, including group demos and webinars, by managing their setup and execution while coordinating cross-functionally with product marketing, sales, customer marketing, and account managers to drive leads and new sale/upsell opportunities.
  • Assist with the design, planning, and optimization of demand generation programs (content marketing, outbound campaigns, etc.) to drive sales and renewal pipelines, including those targeted to specific non-profit verticals and buyer personas.
  • Support the creation of marketing collateral and content as requested, including case studies, one-pagers, webinar research and/or decks, blog posts, toolkits and white papers.
  • Help drive activation of key marketing programs by the sales and partner success teams, providing guidance on how best to use marketing assets to drive engagement, and conversely, communicate sales and partner success pain points back to marketing leadership.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in a marketing or communications role
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills
  • Detail-oriented and a self-starter
  • Willingness to experiment and adapt approach based on data
  • Experience with marketing automation and CRM software, particularly Hubspot and Salesforce, a plus
  • Intellectual curiosity that drives a willingness to learn and take on new challenges
  • Comfortable moving quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Project management and problem-solving mentality

An "active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.

An "Armed forces service medal veteran" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at .

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
  • Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
  • Intellectual or developmental disability
  • Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
  • Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
  • Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports
  • Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)
  • Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities
  • Partial or complete paralysis (any cause)
  • Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema
  • Short stature (dwarfism)

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Sobre a Lemon: as mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. A Lemon existe para facilitar que empresas e pessoas impactem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de energia mais barata e limpa. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, oferecendo atendimento próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico. Somos apoiados por investidores globais em tecnologia e buscamos construir um time diverso com experiências e formações distintas para criar a nova era da energia limpa.

Sobre o time de tech: o time de Tecnologia da Lemon é o coração da nossa inovação e crescimento. Nossa tecnologia é criada e mantida por times multidisciplinares, responsáveis por desenvolver soluções escaláveis que impulsionam a nossa missão de revolucionar o setor de energia limpa. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde a criatividade e a excelência técnica são valorizadas. Usamos Google Cloud BigQuery como data warehouse e SQL para as transformações entre as camadas do nosso lakehouse, buscando governança e qualidade de dados alinhadas ao negócio. Estamos em constante evolução e esperamos que você contribua para isso também. Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe de ponta e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável, a Lemon é o lugar certo para você.

O que você vai fazer

  • Ter a oportunidade de ajudar a transformar em unicórnio uma empresa com um dos maiores potenciais do mercado brasileiro;
  • Ajudar na remodelagem do ambiente analítico da empresa, sendo referência no uso de dados e traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas robustas;
  • Aumentar a confiabilidade dos insights baseados em dados com boas práticas de modelagem de dados em produtos de dados fundacionais e derivados;
  • Ser responsável pelas pipelines de transformação dos dados nas diferentes camadas do nosso ambiente analítico, garantindo a qualidade dos dados entregues;
  • Ser um dos pivôs no aculturamento da empresa em Governança, Qualidade e Confiabilidade de dados;
  • Apoiar e mentorar colegas em práticas de engenharia analítica, ajudando a elevar o nível técnico do time.

O perfil que buscamos

  • Profunda mentalidade de ownership, demonstrando forte responsabilidade pelo que constrói e mantém;
  • Comunicativo, responsivo e didático, com capacidade de traduzir construções técnicas em explicações tangíveis ao negócio;
  • Colaborativo e responsável, ajudando de forma proativa seus colegas sem prejudicar seus próprios compromissos;
  • Interessado pelo negócio e com vontade de entender suas regras, características e particularidades — queremos alguém que se envolva, entenda e questione;
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade para colaborar em um ambiente de constante dinamismo. Somos uma startup e tomadas de decisão rápidas e assertivas fazem parte da nossa essência.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • SQL avançado (otimização, CTEs, window functions);
  • Fluência em metodologias de modelagem analítica de dados (Data Vault, Kimball, Star Schema etc.);
  • Conceitos como Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Lakehouse, Data Mesh;
  • Fundamentos de Data Quality e suas dimensões, frameworks e estratégias de implementação;
  • Noções de BigQuery (GCP) - experiência em boas práticas e performance;
  • Versionamento de código (Git) e boas práticas no uso de esteiras de produtização (CI/CD).

Será um diferencial se você já tiver conhecimentos em

  • Programação em Python;
  • Dataform ou dbt;
  • Experiência com pipelines de ingestão de APIs, webhooks e arquivos de diferentes formatos;
  • Experiência com tratamento de dados semiestruturados;
  • Experiência com orquestradores de dados (por exemplo, Airflow).

O que a gente oferece

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Materiais de escritório;
  • Coworking em todo o país;
  • Cartão Caju flexível (utilizável nas categorias alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, educação, saúde e cultura);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de saúde mental e bem-estar (Zenklub);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Lemon Feriados (dias de folga adicionais próximos a feriados).

Diversidade e inclusão

Aqui na Lemon a diversidade é um compromisso ético. Somos engajados em nos tornar uma empresa cada vez mais diversa e, se você se sentir confortável, gostaríamos de saber na candidatura se se identifica/declara pertencente a algum grupo de diversidade. Encorajamos candidaturas de pessoas com diferentes histórias e vivências para um ambiente mais inclusivo.

title: Commissioned Sales Representative - LATAM Region (Remote)
description:
About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

Descrição

Acreditamos que cada negócio merece uma base sólida e segura para crescer. Nossa missão é simplificar a contabilidade e oferecer dados claros, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento.

Objetivo da Função: Garantir a conformidade fiscal e contábil, apurando tributos, conferindo balancetes e realizando lançamentos contábeis, com autonomia analítica . O analista deve suprir o gestor com informações confiáveis , apresentar soluções e prestar contas proativamente, assegurando qualidade e eficiência nos processos.

Requisitos

Formação: Graduação em Ciências Contábeis.

Experiência:

  • Vivência com lançamentos contábeis e conferência de balancetes.
  • Experiência com Simples Nacional e Lucro Presumido.
  • Apuração de impostos e declarações acessórias (SPED, DCTF, etc.).

Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Legislação tributária federal, estadual e municipal.
  • Pacote Office (Excel – fórmulas e planilhas).
  • Análise e interpretação de documentos fiscais.

Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Comunicação assertiva com clientes e equipe.
  • Proatividade e postura analítica.
  • Autonomia para apresentar soluções.
  • Prestação de contas estruturada ao gestor.
  • Organização, disciplina e gestão do tempo.
  • Resiliência e adaptação a mudanças.

Atribuições

  • Realizar a importação e conferência de lançamentos de notas de entrada, saída, serviços prestados e tomados.
  • Realizar apuração de tributos (Simples Nacional, IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ISS, ICMS).
  • Conferir balancetes de empresas do Simples Nacional, garantindo consistência das informações.
  • Realizar lançamentos contábeis de empresas do Lucro Presumido, preparando-os para conferência final do gestor.
  • Interpretar corretamente notas fiscais (NCM, CST, CFOP, etc.), assegurando tributação correta.
  • Elaborar e entregar declarações acessórias dentro dos prazos legais.
  • Prestar contas regularmente ao gestor, comunicando avanços, inconsistências e soluções propostas.
  • Atuar proativamente no contato com clientes, esclarecendo pendências e confirmando informações.
  • Buscar melhoria contínua dos processos fiscais e contábeis, utilizando ferramentas de automação (Nibo, SCI Novo Visual, etc.).
  • Cumprir horários e prazos estabelecidos, mantendo organização e disciplina.
  • Auxílio home office (R$ 206 + equipamentos).
  • Ambiente 100% digital e estruturado.
  • Trilha de desenvolvimento e capacitação.

Join to apply for the Senior Growth Content Marketer role at Ottomatik.io

Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a Senior Growth Content Marketer!

Note To Applicants

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Growth Content Marketer with a creative spark and a proven ability to grow organic channels through compelling, multi-format content. This high-impact, hands-on role involves owning the full content lifecycle—from ideation and production to publishing and performance optimization—across written, video, visual, and educational formats.

This is a maker’s role, ideal for someone who thrives on both strategy and execution, and is deeply proficient with modern AI tools and content platforms. You’ll be a key player in our growth marketing efforts, directly contributing to our SEO, CRO, brand visibility, and lead generation objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organic Content Channel Growth: Own end-to-end content creation and publishing across blog, YouTube, LinkedIn, and more; continuously optimize content channels based on analytics and business priorities; repurpose and remix content across formats to increase reach and ROI.
  • Video Production: Script, record, edit, and publish original videos in both long-form and short-form formats; create social-ready clips from long-form content using tools like Descript, CapCut, or Premiere Pro; act as the face of the brand in videos, explainers, and live formats.
  • On-Camera & Event Hosting: Host or co-host podcasts, webinars, roundtables, and video interviews; plan and lead live events, from workshops to virtual summits.
  • Visual Content Creation: Design eye-catching visuals like infographics, thumbnails, carousels, and branded graphics; utilize AI tools (e.g., DALL·E, Midjourney) alongside Canva, Photoshop, or Figma for high-quality output.
  • SEO & Web Content: Write SEO-driven blog posts, landing pages, and conversion-focused copy; collaborate with SEO teams to align content structure, keyword usage, and internal linking; perform content audits and optimize pages for performance and clarity.
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Improve web content and blog performance via testing and data analysis; refine messaging, layout, and CTAs to drive conversions; analyze competitor content and iterate accordingly.
  • Content Repurposing: Break down long-form assets into emails, graphics, video clips, and social posts; leverage AI tools like ChatGPT to ideate, draft, and repackage content efficiently.
  • Educational & Messaging Content: Collaborate with leadership and sales teams to ensure consistent brand messaging; create course materials, sales enablement content, and thought leadership assets.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years in content marketing or content production with a portfolio of organic channel growth.
  • Native or near-native English writing and editing skills, with fluency in verbal communication.
  • Expertise in video creation (recording, editing, publishing) with a strong sense of design and color.
  • Strong on-camera presence and comfort hosting events or webinars.
  • Proficiency in AI tools (ChatGPT, DALL·E, Midjourney) and design/video platforms, using them to amplify content creation.
  • Ability to produce high-quality content independently across media types.
  • Deep understanding of SEO, CRO, and B2B buyer journeys.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines autonomously.

Culture Fit – Core Values

  • Proactive – takes initiative and drives projects forward.
  • Simplicity – communicates and executes with clarity.
  • Expedient – delivers high-quality results efficiently.
  • Growth-Oriented – eager to learn and continuously improve.
  • Encouraging – collaborates with positivity and support.
  • Expertise – demonstrates mastery in their craft.

Nice to Have

  • Podcast production or repurposing experience.
  • Background in educational or instructional content creation.
  • Familiarity with tools like Webflow, Figma, Notion, Ahrefs, or Hotjar.
  • Experience with performance analytics and dashboarding.
  • Knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem.

What Success Looks Like

  • You grow one or more organic content channels through your own creative execution.
  • You deliver a steady stream of engaging, multi-format content that drives traffic, engagement, and leads.
  • You independently produce and scale content initiatives with minimal oversight.
  • You become a core contributor to marketing priorities across SEO, CRO, messaging, and education.

USA Time Zone

Compensation: $3,000 USD/Month

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

The Commercial Performance & Revenue Management function is responsible for assessing the commercial and financial results of our business and guiding leadership on risks and opportunities across all ABI markets. We monitor ABI performance on a short-term (daily) and long-term (10-year plan) range, developing deep commercial and financial knowledge of each market to inform GHQ leaders and help set their strategy for future initiatives related to portfolio management, pricing, and investment. You will report to the Supervisor Managed Services

  • You will focus on remote managed services for data centers located in manufacturing facilities. Have technical expertise for computer environments and will be instrumental in bridging the industrial and information technology paradigms.

You will update and author Technical Notes and other documentation to inform Rockwell Automation personnel, domestic or international, of solutions to commonly experienced problems, work around, installation practices that create problems to improve customer satisfaction and acceptance.

BASIC REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, computer programming, or similar.

PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS:

  • VMWare Certified Professional (VCP).
  • 3 years' experience as a VMware engineer.
  • Proficiency in VMware associated programs and coding languages, such as Windows Server, MS IIS, SAN/vSAN architectures.
  • Knowledge of the fundamentals of VMware solutions and related technologies.
  • Programming Language for cloud platforms: Python, Java, JavaScript, Power Shell
  • Exceptional analytical and technical skills.
  • Availability to resolve urgent VMware environment problems outside of business hours.
  • Familiarity with network and SAN switching technologies.
  • Good English reading, writing and verbal communication skills
  • Strict adherence to company standards and procedures.
  • Excellent trouble shooting skills

  • Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.

  • On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

We believe that employee diversity is an important element of our common future. We provide opportunities for talent growth with the entire organization. title: QA Engineer Specialist | Business Architecture Services
description:
QA Engineer Specialist | Business Architecture Services

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.
*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a QA Engineer Specialist in our BASE area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country.
At the BASE (Business Architecture Services) Focus Area, we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a truly scalable platform to support dozens of millions of active users and clients around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models. In this role, you will go beyond testing — you will drive quality across services and teams, mentoring engineers, shaping automation frameworks, and ensuring Wellhub continues to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-centric solutions.
As a Q.A. Engineer you will take end-to-end ownership of the quality of the most critical product flows and deliveries. You will be involved from the very beginning of the product lifecycle, helping with the product requirements, defining and building comprehensive test scenarios, performing in-depth exploratory testing, and automating mission-critical flows. Your work will ensure backward compatibility, performance, reliability, and overall product excellence.In addition, you will define and continuously improve the testing pipeline, driving best practices in automated testing and mentoring developers to elevate the team’s quality standards.
This role combines strong analytical QA expertise with engineering skills in a critical position that delivers meaningful impact across the organization, spanning from overall test planning to execution.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead the design and implementation of test strategies (manual, automated, and exploratory) for complex distributed systems.
  • Define and evolve quality standards, frameworks, and processes across multiple services.
  • Mentor and guide software engineers, fostering a culture of ownership for quality.
  • Partner with product managers and engineering leaders to assess risks, define acceptance criteria, and shape solutions.
  • Drive test automation adoption, building scalable frameworks for APIs, backend services, and integrations.
  • Champion performance, load, and reliability testing as part of the development lifecycle.
  • Ensure quality gates and CI/CD pipelines provide fast, reliable feedback to teams.
  • Identify systemic quality issues and propose improvements in architecture, tooling, and processes.
  • Act as a quality advocate, ensuring we deliver not just working software, but trusted and delightful experiences to users.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A QA professional with a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Solid experience in QA Engineering, with a strong background in automation (Cypress, Playwright, Rest-assured, SuperTest, Bruno, Cucumber, Postman, or similar).
  • Experienced with API testing (REST/GraphQL) and data validations in SQL/NoSQL databases.
  • Familiar with cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Preferred but not required experience in performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling, Locust, K6) and their application to large-scale systems.
  • Experienced in risk-based testing, exploratory testing, and working with distributed systems.
  • Solid experience working with distributed systems using asynchronous communication (Kafka)
  • Familiar with SQL, being able to navigate complex data domains
  • Comfortable leading cross-team initiatives, influencing quality practices, and driving alignment on testing strategies.
  • Solid communication skills in English, able to articulate quality goals, trade-offs, and improvements across cultures and geographies.
  • A proactive, collaborative problem-solver who sees quality as a shared responsibility across engineering.
  • Experience with observability tools (Datadog, NewRelic, Kibana, Prometheus, Grafana Loki, or similar).
  • Preferred but not required experience with contract testing (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract, Dredd, or similar).

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in QA Engineering, automation test, API testing, and distributed systems using asynchronous communicationare mandatory requirements

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.
