When you think of InComm Payments, think of Innovative Payments Technology. We were founded over 30 years ago and continue to be a pioneer in the payment (FinTech) industry. Since our inception, we have grown to be a team of over 3,000 employees in 35 countries around the world. We own over 400 global technical patents and a network that includes over 525,000 points of retail distribution that points to our industry expertise.

We are significantly growing our Engineering and IT teams in Brazil and are focused on finding talent for various financial technology (Fintech) engineering, database, development, and testing teams.

InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future. We anticipate developing future leaders for our teams in Brazil!

Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses! All positions are CLT.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter, Facebook, or Instagram.

About This Opportunity

We are looking for a senior Systems Analyst with experience in payments/fintech to join our team! In this role, you will be responsible for creating SQL queries, interpreting SQL scripts, continuously monitoring assigned platforms for performance, providing high-level design for data flows, engaging in deployments, and collaborating with cross functional teams to best enhance platforms and support our customers. You will also serve as an owner of the platforms and be knowledgeable of all operational and maintenance activities up to monitoring the efforts. Professional English communication skills required.

This position is CLT and Fully Remote in Brazil . Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!

Responsibilities

  • Continuously monitor assigned platforms for performance and operational excellence ensuring established SLAs are maintained and contributes recommendations for process and/or platform improvements
  • Exhibit a sense of ownership for assigned platform(s), and maintain/grow the knowledgebase of Clients, Merchants, and Users serviced by the platform
  • Periodically survey platform customers to gauge and drive improvements in customer satisfaction, where appropriate
  • Create SQL queries and understand SQL scripts to enhance the platform and support customers.
  • Parse, analyze and understand system log files
  • Strong knowledge of payment message formats and data file formats associated with assigned platforms.
  • Proactively monitor the performance of assigned platforms and raise potential performance or reliability issues to development and support teams to investigate/address, to avoid impact on system availability/customer experience
  • Plan and coordinate payment solutions and enhancements with the development team
  • Meet and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to establish project scope, system goals, and requirements
  • Provides input on high-level design documents for data and message flows and detailed technical requirements
  • Collaborate with QA testing in the research and writing of test cases along with participating in system testing
  • Engaged in production deployment for coordination and verification as the owner of the platform
  • Owner of platform and knowledgeable of all operational and maintenance activities up to monitoring the efforts
  • Create and maintain platform documentation including process flows, design/architecture, operational playbooks, escalation procedures, and training materials as needed.
  • Create Software Release and Change Management tickets as well as internal IT request tickets for system updates

Qualifications

  • Associate, Technologo, or Bachelor Degree preferred
  • Ideal candidate will have experience in the payment industry in one of the following roles as a System Analyst, Business Analyst, Project Manager, QA Engineer, or Software Engineer role
  • Work effectively alone and in team environments with quality and timely results
  • Demonstrated ability to work with Customers
  • Able to work under tight deadlines while providing high-quality work
  • Customer Service orientation with the ability to effectively interact with users of all levels
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Professional English communication skills.
  • Strong research, analytical, and troubleshooting skills
  • Support after-hours coverage/escalation

We are seeking a Senior Backend Developer with 10+ years of experience and deep expertise in NestJS, API architecture, and multi-tenant systems to join our team.   • Contribute to onboarding processes by setting up tools, frameworks, and engineering standards.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders to ensure reliable and timely delivery.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in backend development.
  • Deep expertise with NestJS (architecture, testing, and production deployment).
  • Strong background in multi-tenant API systems and scalable backend architectures.
  • Experience in financial services or digital banking is highly desirable.
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms.
  • Knowledge of observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana.
  • Strong leadership, mentoring, and coaching skills.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Spanish.

Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company.

With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

Overview

Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first

Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 50 healthcare company with a legacy of innovation, evolving from skilled nursing and hospitals to one of the largest health benefits providers in the US. At the core of this evolution is Humana’s Insurance Segment, which provides Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and other health plans to millions. By integrating insurance with care delivery through CenterWell, Humana is improving healthcare access, coordination, and affordability for its members.

Humana’s Insurance Segment Strategy team plays a pivotal role in defining the future of Humana’s Medicare and Medicaid businesses, which generate the majority of the company’s total revenue and earnings. Comprised of experienced professionals from top-tier consulting firms and leading healthcare organizations, the team works closely with senior leaders across the enterprise to drive high-profile strategy projects that address the business’s most complex challenges and biggest opportunities.

Humana is seeking an experienced team member with meaningful strategy consulting or healthcare strategy experience to join this team. As an Insurance Strategy Lead, you will directly contribute to high-impact strategy projects, engage with executive leadership, and develop actionable recommendations that shape Humana’s long-term direction. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where your insights will help inform Board-level discussions and enterprise-wide strategic priorities.

As a Lead, you will be responsible for deconstructing complex business challenges, conducting targeted research and analysis, and developing sound, data-driven recommendations that help guide Humana’s strategic direction. Your role will be instrumental in synthesizing strategic choices being made across the business unit into cohesive, actionable plans that drive both growth and profitability while improving the health of Humana’s members. You will also help shape implementation considerations and work closely with business owners to transition strategies into execution, ensuring that recommendations translate into meaningful business impact.

Recent example projects include development of a 5-year growth strategy for Humana’s Insurance business, developing a refreshed membership acquisition strategy, identifying key go-to-market priorities, assessing the performance of strategic initiatives and business areas, evolving key facets of the Medicare Advantage growth strategy, and identifying improvement opportunities for a key business function.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to translate strategy into execution

title: Pre-Award Specialist
description:
Overview

University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus

Department: Cancer Center

Working Title: Pre-Award Specialist

Position #: – Requisition #: 37750

Job Summary:

The Oncology Clinical Research Pre Award Specialist is responsible for developing, negotiating, finalizing and reviewing budgets for clinical trials conducted by faculty members of the University of Colorado Cancer Center at University of Colorado Hospital (UCH). This position requires discretion, analytical skill and personal responsibility to identify, research, collaborate and creatively solve problems in a changing environment while remaining within system, institutional, and state fiscal policies. This position works extensively with industry sponsors, CU finance contacts, clinical staff, faculty members, the University of Colorado Hospital, administrative staff throughout the University, as well as representatives from various departments and CU Medicine. A lot of training is provided up front as this position must learn a Medicare Coverage Analysis (MCA), oncology clinical trial protocols, and processes and procedures of the oncology clinical trial Post Award specialist, the oncology clinical trial finance/billing specialist, and clinic staff.

Job trainings and functions include reviewing and analyzing complex oncology clinical trial protocols, drafting a study-specific budget to account for all procedural and labor costs, working with the clinical trial system OnCoreTM, calendar builders and Project/Research managers to ensure all costs are properly accounted for. This position is responsible for contracts/ grants solicitation and administration, grant/agreement preparation, review and negotiation, regulatory compliance, sponsor communication and pre-award management. This position will have budgetary oversight and is responsible for the advancement of oncology clinical trial contracts and amendments sponsored by industry, cooperative groups, federal grants/contracts and investigator initiated clinical trials.

Key Responsibilities

Specific Examples of Work Performed (All Levels):

  • Review clinical trial protocols in order to draft a study-specific budget that accounts for all procedural and labor costs.

  • Negotiate budgets with industry sponsors.

  • Review and negotiate contractual payment terms.

  • Work with the Clinical Research Administration Office (CRAO) to review and approve final contracts (budget related sections and exhibits).

  • Work with OnCoreTM calendar builders to ensure financial information in OnCoreTM accurately reflects procedures, rates and prices in the negotiated budgets.

  • Review contractual documents to ensure final negotiated terms have been incorporated.

  • Route contractual documents for non-budget increase amendments.

  • Collaborate with Finance Specialists, Regulatory Affairs and Clinical Coordinators to ensure the negotiated budget terms are understood and billed correctly.

  • Complete pre-award reviews using OnCoreTM and train other finance team members in this task if required.

Additional Duties for Level II:

  • Experience with clinical studies calendar specifications and protocol/subject related procedures.

  • Work with Clinical Project Managers and demonstrate advanced research budgeting knowledge.

Additional Duties for Level III:

  • Train Oncology Clinical Trial Budget Specialist I in the clinical trials management software OnCoreTM.

  • Train Oncology Clinical Trial Budget Specialist I in budget management and negotiation.

  • Train Oncology Clinical Trial Budget Specialist I in budget calendar specifications and protocol/subject related procedures.

  • Act as resource to assist other Clinical Research Budget Specialists as needed.

  • Identify process improvement opportunities and involve others across interrelated teams to evaluate.

Work Location

Remote – this role is eligible to work remotely, but the employee must be in the United States.

Why Join Us

The University of Colorado Cancer Center stands at the forefront of cancer research and patient care in Colorado. As the state's only National Cancer Institute (NCI) designated Comprehensive Cancer Center, we hold a prestigious distinction recognizing our contributions to research, clinical trials, prevention, and cancer control. Our guiding vision is to prevent and conquer cancer, together. Our mission is to unite our community to overcome cancer through innovation, discovery, prevention, early detection, multidisciplinary care, and education.

We have more than 300 members, including physicians and researchers, who conduct patient-centered research to develop innovative technologies and treatments. We also employ nearly 300 staff members who help expand the reach of the CU Cancer Center. Our expertise across cancer types enables world-class treatment and hope for patients with difficult cancers.

Why work for the University?

We offer amazing benefits, including generous holiday, vacation and sick leave. The University of Colorado offers a comprehensive benefits package including:

  • Medical: Multiple plan options

  • Dental: Multiple plan options

  • Additional Insurance: Disability, Life, Vision

  • Retirement 401(a) Plan: Employer contributes 10% of gross pay

  • Paid Time Off: Accruals over the year

  • Vacation Days: 22/year (maximum accrual 352 hours)

  • Sick Days: 15/year (unlimited maximum accrual)

  • Holiday Days: 10/year

  • Tuition Benefit: Employees have access to this benefit on all CU campuses

  • ECO Pass: Reduced rate RTD Bus and light rail service

There are many additional perks and programs with CU Advantage.

To see what benefits are available, please visit:

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist I (Entry):

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in finance, business administration, healthcare or other related field.

Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist II (Intermediate):

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in finance, business administration, healthcare or other related field.

  • Two (2) years of professional experience working in Oncology Clinical Research Finance.

Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist III (Senior):

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in finance, business administration, healthcare or other related field.

  • Three (3) years of professional experience working in Oncology Clinical Research Finance.

Substitutions for all levels: Related experience in budget, finance, business administration or clinical field may substitute for the degree on a year-for-year basis.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications for Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist I:

  • Experience working with clinical trials management software, preferably OnCoreTM

  • One (1) or more years’ experience in a clinical or clinical research setting.

  • Six (6) months or more experience reading and understanding clinical research protocols, specifically oncology, is preferred.

  • Experience managing budgets.

  • Experience with clinical studies calendar specifications and protocol/subject related procedures.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

All Levels:

  • Good comprehension of contract terminology and ability to draft and negotiate contract budget terms.

  • Ability to work across different departments.

  • Organizational skills, ability to multi-task, adapt to change, and handle competing priorities.

  • Financial analytical skills and ability to troubleshoot problems and pursue resolutions.

  • Critical thinking and decision-making with strong attention to detail.

  • Logical thinking with the ability to learn and process large amounts of information.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Familiarity with medical and clinical research budgeting concepts.

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

How to Apply:

For full consideration, please submit the following documents:

2. Curriculum vitae / Resume

3. Three to five professional references with contact details

Overview

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

Overview

Swanson, and V8.

Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.

Responsibilities

Maintenance Reliability Specialist

How you will make history here..

We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Reliability Specialist to join our team in the food manufacturing industry. This role is tailored for professionals with a foundational understanding of maintenance, ideally within a bakery or food production setting. This position is responsible for implementing advanced reliability tools, work processes, and supporting reliability efforts for the plant. They will work to improve equipment and process performance by applying reliability principles, statistical data analysis and supporting the work process to support the Company's overall strategic objectives with a focus on safety, people, quality, delivery and cost.

What you will do

  • The Reliability Specialist will focus on addressing recurrent issues impacting plant efficiency and profitability, fostering a proactive approach to eliminating downtime and improving machinery performance.
  • Identify and manage asset reliability risks through loss elimination, risk and Life Cycle Asset Management
  • Analyze root causes of recurring issues affecting equipment performance and plant efficiency.
  • Develop and implement effective solutions to minimize downtime and enhance throughput in the manufacturing process.
  • Conduct an analysis of reliability problems to determine what reliability tools are required for the particular situation.
  • Collaborate with maintenance personnel and production teams to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement.
  • Monitor equipment performance metrics and recommend best practices to improve reliability and operational performance.
  • Document and communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders, promoting continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support the implementation of preventative maintenance strategies to mitigate potential disruptions.
  • 75% - Reliability/Project Management:
    • Develops engineering solutions to repetitive failures and all other problems that adversely affect plant operations.
    • Utilize data analysis techniques that can include statistical process control; reliability modeling and prediction; Six Sigma methodology; root cause failure analysis (RCFA); and corrective and preventative actions systems.
    • Delivers a through timely, cost-effective implementation to optimize operational effectiveness and efficiency.
    • Participate in the design and installation, scheduling and capital funds of cost-effective equipment modifications to help improve safety, reliability, and throughput.
    • Provides active technical support for all plant departments, to drive performance objectives and improvement initiatives.
  • 25% - Strategic Partner:
    • Provide ongoing leadership for Lean transformation and other continuous improvement initiatives. Actively participate in and help drive the 5S Program, kaizen events, standard work development, etc.
    • Considers the impact of costs during the design phase or remedial action for correcting reliability problems on installed equipment and performs root cause analysis to help prevent failures.
    • Participates in final check-out of new installations. This includes factory and site acceptance testing that will assure adherence to functional specifications.

Who you will work with

  • Reporting into our Director of Site Operations and our Maintenance Manager

Qualifications

What you bring to the table... (Must Have)

  • High school diploma or GED
  • 2.5+ years of reliability/maintenance experience in a manufacturing environment.

It would be great if you have... (Nice to Have)

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred
  • 3+ years of reliability/maintenance experience within food manufacturing
  • PLC experience

Compensation and Benefits

The target base salary range for this full-time, salaried position is between $74,700-$107,400. Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. Total pay may include other forms of compensation. In addition, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Partner for more information about our total rewards package.

The Company is committed to providing equal opportunity for employees and qualified applicants in all aspects of the employment relationship, including consideration for employment, without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, marital status, protected veteran status, disability, age, religion, or any other classification protected by law.

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. We’re not just another recruiting firm - we focus on placing candidates with exceptional US and EU founders who prioritize the long-term success of their team members. We also provide retention bonuses at 3, 6, 9, and 12 months, as well as community-driven benefits like an annual retreat.

About the Company

The Partner Company offers a unique blend of shuffleboard fun, tropical vibes, and events in Brooklyn and Chicago. They’re looking to grow their digital presence with engaging, location-specific content and targeted advertising to drive foot traffic, event attendance, and brand loyalty.

Role Overview

As a Marketing Strategist, you’ll drive the online presence of the Partner's Company at Brooklyn and Chicago locations through engaging social media content and targeted advertising. You'll own content strategy and community management across Instagram and TikTok, run Google Ads campaigns, and track performance to inform future creative and strategic decisions.   • Digital Advertising & Analytics
    • Plan, launch, and optimize Google Ads campaigns for events, leagues, and brand awareness.
    • Manage boosted posts and paid campaigns on Instagram and TikTok.
    • Track and report on key performance indicators including reach, engagement, conversions, and ROI.
    • Deliver clear monthly performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Creative Innovation & Brand Growth
    • Propose and test new content series or campaign ideas each quarter.
    • Stay on top of social media trends to keep the brand’s content fresh and relevant.
    • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal marketing and event teams to align messaging and objectives.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 2–4 years of overall professional experience, with at least 1–2 years directly managing Instagram, TikTok, and Google Ads for hospitality, entertainment, or lifestyle brands.
  • Strong understanding of current social media trends, meme culture, and visual storytelling.
  • Hands-on experience with social media scheduling tools.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into strategy.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with remote and in-person teams.
  • Strong time-management skills; able to juggle multiple priorities and locations independently.
  • Portfolio or clear case studies showcasing successful campaigns and measurable results.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Content creation skills (e.g., video editing, basic design using Canva or Adobe Suite).
  • Experience coordinating or working directly with event-based marketing.
  • Familiarity with TikTok’s creator tools and Instagram Reels best practices.
  • Background in hospitality, nightlife, or entertainment environments.
  • Passion for fun, community-focused spaces.

KPIs & Success Metrics

  • Engagement Rate: Improve average likes, comments, shares, and saves across platforms.
  • Follower Growth: Achieve consistent growth on both Instagram and TikTok.
  • Content Output: Publish 2–3 posts per week per platform, plus stories and reels.
  • Community Management: Respond to 100% of messages and comments within 24 business hours.
  • Ad Performance: Meet or exceed industry benchmarks on CTR, conversions, and ROAS.
  • Event Uplift: Demonstrate increased attendance or signups linked to campaigns.
  • Reporting: Deliver clear, strategic performance reports monthly.
  • Innovation: Launch at least one new content series or idea every quarter.

Benefits

Compensation Package

  • Competitive Salary: Based on experience and skills
  • Remote Work: Fully remote—work from anywhere
  • Generous PTO: Ample paid time off to rest and recharge
  • Direct Mentorship: Grow through guidance from international industry experts
  • Learning & Development: Ongoing access to resources for professional growth
  • Global Networking: Work and connect with professionals around the world
  • Work-Life Balance: Flexible hours that support a healthy work-life balance

  • Skills Assessment and filling Internal Forms

  • Client Onboarding

If this role aligns with your skills and career goals, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to take the next step in your journey with Pearl.

To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. Your decision to complete the form and your answer will not harm you in any way. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at .

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
  • Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
  • Intellectual or developmental disability
  • Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
  • Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
  • Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports
  • Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)
  • Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities
  • Partial or complete paralysis (any cause)
  • Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema
  • Short stature (dwarfism)
  • Traumatic brain injury

Program Specialist, CX

As a Program Specialist on the Customer Experience team, you will play a vital role in our ability to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Working alongside stakeholders— Product, Engineering, Marketing, Business Intelligence— you will optimize the behind-the-scenes operations that enable Alma to deliver high-quality support at scale. What you’ll do

  • Own program execution and operational metrics for assigned initiatives, ensuring we meet our KPIs and OKRs.

Who you are

  • You have 2+ years of experience in operations, program/project management, or business operations, ideally within customer support or CX operations, at a fast-paced tech/startup environment.

  • You have experience managing cross-functional stakeholders across levels and can confidently provide feedback laterally, upward, and downward.
  • You thrive in complex and ambiguous environments where flexibility and ruthless prioritization are required to manage competing priorities.

  1. 1. Quem pode se inscrever no processo seletivo? Qualquer pessoa que atenda aos requisitos mínimos descritos na página da vaga na Gupy pode se inscrever. Verifique a seção "Requisitos" da vaga para a qual você está aplicando para garantir a sua compatibilidade com a vaga.

  8. 8. Posso corrigir ou atualizar minha inscrição após enviá-la? Sim, você pode atualizar seus dados antes do prazo final de inscrição, acessando sua conta no site e fazendo as alterações necessárias diretamente no site tomeducacao.gupy.io.
  9. 9. Como posso acompanhar o status da minha inscrição? Você pode acompanhar o status de sua inscrição e do processo seletivo na área "Minha Inscrição" no nosso site tomeducacao.gupy.io, onde estarão as atualizações sobre cada etapa.
  10. 10. O que devo fazer se não receber o e-mail de confirmação da inscrição? Verifique sua caixa de spam ou lixo eletrônico. Caso o e-mail não esteja lá, entre em contato com a equipe de suporte pelo e-mail ou pelo telefone .
  11. 11. Há vagas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD)? Sim, o processo seletivo conta com vagas destinadas a pessoas com deficiência (PCD).
  12. 12. Qual é a duração do processo seletivo? O processo seletivo pode variar em duração, mas normalmente leva entre 20 a 60 dias, desde o início das inscrições até a divulgação do resultado final. Confira o andamento em seu e-mail ou no nosso site tomeducacao.com.br.
  13. 13. Onde posso encontrar mais informações sobre os cargos disponíveis? Todas as informações sobre as vagas, incluindo requisitos e responsabilidades, estão detalhadas na página do processo seletivo, disponível no nosso site tomeducacao.com.br.
  14. 14. E se eu tiver mais dúvidas? Caso tenha outras perguntas, você pode entrar em contato com nossa equipe pelo e-mail ou pelo telefone .

description:
Overview

Job Title: AI Engineer (Search Engine)

About the Company: Insight Global's Client

Type: 10 month extending contract

Compensation: Shared upon initial WhatsApp screening call

Location: Fully Remote

Working Hours: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM BRT (9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST)

  • Ability to work full-time hours on a contract basis (10AM - 6PM BRT)
  • Strong communication skills
  • CLT ONLY ( This cannot change to PJ)
  • No health benefits providd in CLT benefits
  • Needs to be able to start within 2-3 weeks

  • 1+ years of experience as a Search Engineer or AI Engineer
  • Search Technology Experience – OpenSearch, building scalable search systems
  • 2+ years of Python development experience, including API creation, model training, testing, and general backend programming

Nice to Have Skills

We are hiring one AI / LLM Engineers (1 Mid-Level) to join a small, focused team building backend features for an existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) service. Your primary focus will be building and optimizing RAG models for search across large-scale medical and scientific documents, including pre-processing and embedding over half a billion documents to ensure they are searchable and contextually accurate. You’ll work on semantic chunking strategies, improving the automated evaluation pipeline, and fine-tuning LLMs for textual RAG use cases. The role involves hands-on experimentation, model development, and backend engineering, with deployments to non-prod environments and collaboration with DevOps for production rollout. While this is a heads-down, individual contributor role, strong communication and collaboration with the team are essential.

title: Sustainability Manager
description:
General Description:

The Sustainability Manager will be responsible for driving the company’s sustainability strategy with a strong focus on Scope 3 emissions. This role will identify and mitigate sustainability risks, embed sustainable practices into procurement and supply chain operations, manage sustainability data and reporting, and communicate progress transparently to internal and external stakeholders. The role will report to the Head of Procurement & Sustainability Excellence.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop, implement, and monitor the company’s sustainability strategy with emphasis on Scope 3 emissions reduction, ensuring alignment with corporate goals and values.
  • Manage sustainability budgets, including projects and future financial projections through 2027.
  • Identify, assess, and prioritize sustainability risks and opportunities across the value chain; maintain and update climate risk mapping (e.g., Power BI dashboards based on BSI data).
  • Integrate climate-related risks into enterprise risk management (ERM) systems and mitigation plans, and ensure effective tracking and follow-up.
  • Establish and maintain accurate Scope 3 data tables, target-setting frameworks, and emissions footprint repositories.
  • Track and report supplier sustainability data to meet internal needs and external obligations (e.g., sustainability reports, Hong Kong Stock Exchange requirements).
  • Collaborate with sourcing managers (primarily direct, with some indirect) to embed Scope 3 reduction into category strategies, sourcing decisions, and implementation plans.
  • Develop and implement sustainable procurement policies, including ESG sourcing guidance, supplier evaluation criteria, and performance measurement.
  • Lead supplier engagement initiatives, including climate questionnaires, maturity assessments, outreach, and training sessions, to improve supplier performance on sustainability.
  • Support supplier development programs, including diversity, audits, partnerships, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Educate suppliers and third-party vendors on climate awareness and emissions reduction expectations.
  • Research and evaluate new sustainability technologies and trends (e.g., AI resource use, green chemistry, sustainable construction, and packaging) for business impact and adoption potential.
  • Provide regular updates and reports to procurement leadership and other stakeholders (e.g., PLT updates, ESG sourcing guidance, sustainability reports).
  • Design and deliver internal sustainability education and awareness programs, including recorded webinars and training for procurement teams.
  • Ensure compliance with evolving regulations, industry best practices, and responsible procurement due diligence requirements.
  • Build business cases for sustainability initiatives, drive organizational change, and act as a trusted advisor on sustainable business practices.

Minimum Requirements – Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business, or related field (advanced degree preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sustainability management, with proven expertise in Scope 3 emissions.

Other Experience:

  • Strong understanding of sustainability and ESG principles, with practical application in procurement and supply chain.
  • Experience developing and implementing supplier engagement and responsible procurement programs.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to build compelling business cases.
  • Excellent project management, organizational, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive change without direct authority.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with experience preparing clear reports and presentations for diverse audiences.
  • Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or a related regulated sector is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while fostering collaboration across teams.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

N/A

Travel:

Approximately 10%

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

Sophos is a global leader and innovator of advanced security solutions for defeating cyberattacks. Secureworks provides the innovative, market-leading Taegis XDR/MDR, identity threat detection and response (ITDR), next-gen SIEM capabilities, managed risk, and a comprehensive set of advisory services. Sophos sells all these solutions through reseller partners, Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) worldwide, defending more than 600,000 organizations worldwide from phishing, ransomware, data theft, other everyday and state-sponsored cybercrimes. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at

Overview

Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Snowflake Data Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team.

Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote - Brazil

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.

Snowflake Data Engineer | About You

As a Snowflake Data Engineer, you are responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and architecture using the Snowflake platform. You bring deep expertise in SQL, Python, and ELT frameworks, along with a strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and best practices. You thrive in analytics-driven environments where clean, efficient data powers strategic decision-making. Detail-oriented and results-driven, you collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align data engineering solutions with business goals, while upholding high standards for quality, security, and performance.

Snowflake Data Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Snowflake to ingest and transform data from diverse sources, including cloud and OLTP systems.
  • Implement robust ETL / ELT processes and validation routines using SQL, Python, and orchestration tools like dbt or Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with Data Analytics, BI, and Product teams to translate business requirements into actionable data products.
  • Ensure data quality through error handling, automated monitoring, and validation processes.
  • Monitor and optimize Snowflake query performance, warehouse usage, and overall pipeline efficiency.
  • Contribute to data governance and security by applying compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, SOC2), implementing access controls, and using data masking techniques.
  • Document data workflows and support scalable, governed data practices aligned with a modern data mesh approach.

Snowflake Data Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of data engineering experience, ideally within SaaS or analytics-driven environments.
  • Hands-on Snowflake experience, including ELT development, schema design, and performance tuning.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data ingestion, transformation, and analysis.
  • Experience with orchestration and transformation tools such as dbt and Apache Airflow.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling (e.g., star schemas, dimensional modeling) and cloud platforms like AWS or Azure.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and compliance standards such as HIPAA and SOC2, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.

Construction and Projects Overview

Target’s distinctive brand love is infused throughout its many physical locations by the Properties teams. Are you ready to help strategically grow Target’s brand through leading-edge design, development, construction, and preservation? As a Lead Estimator you will develop accurate estimates to support capital investment strategies. Evaluate actual vs. estimated costs on all applicable projects and generate cost analysis to make informed decisions based on various implementation strategies. Respond efficiently to cost requests from multiple cross functional groups. Develop conceptual and feasibility cost estimates to help leaders make informed decisions. Maintain market knowledge regarding costs through regular review of industry resources and maintaining strong relationships with general contractors and vendors. Visit project sites as necessary (less than 10% travel).

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

  • Capable of performing quantity take-offs for offsite, onsite, and building trades. Skilled in interpreting construction documents, ESA, and geotechnical reports.

  • Have experience and knowledge with specialized foundation systems, ground improvement techniques, and soil stabilization methods.

  • In-depth experiencein estimating and pricing all Construction Specifications Institute (CSI) divisions, including both building construction and site development scopes.

  • Proven ability to develop accurate cost assessments across all trades and phases of preconstruction.

  • Aptitude to communicate complex cost information in a clear manner to multiple levels of the organization for decisions

This position may be considered for a Remote or Hybrid (known internally at Target as "Flex for Your Day") work arrangement based on Target\'s needs. Job description

  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e habilidades em bancos de dados SQL.
  • Conhecimento em processos relacionados à cadeia produtiva da carne bovina será diferencial.
  • Capacidade analítica, proatividade e bom relacionamento interpessoal.

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company with over 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities worldwide. We provide AI technology solutions for financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine, combining ML/AI with a global workforce of subject matter experts and high-security infrastructure.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We seek qualified professionals (Master’s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will help shape how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, focusing on microbiological sciences. Your feedback and annotations will inform AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts, evaluating the model’s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

  • Monitor market trends such as Open RAN, network disaggregation, automation, and competitor activities to refine sales strategies.

  • Partner with the SUSE Telco ecosystem, including NEPs, SIs, and ISVs, to enhance and bundle offerings and extend opportunities.
  • Collaborate on Account Plans with Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Partner Ecosystem, and Specialist Sales teams to deliver comprehensive solutions and drive traction within target accounts.
  • Identify and prioritize key accounts with strong potential for adopting SUSE products and solutions for core, edge, and RAN environments, setting milestones to maximize opportunities.

Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in enterprise software sales and account management, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets in the Telecommunications industry or selling complex technology to telecom operators.
  • Strong knowledge of the Telco landscape and transformation topics, including NFV, CNFs, 5G/Edge computing, OSS/BSS modernization, and network automation.

  • Analytical skills to understand Telco market trends and regulatory landscapes, applying insights to sales strategies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills for network performance, operational efficiency, and new service creation.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners (NEPs, SIs, ISVs).
  • Experience with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Clari) to manage pipelines and forecast sales.
  • Ability to apply enterprise sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger). Industry certifications in sales or telecommunications are a plus.
  • Understanding of Open Source principles and their importance in Telco (e.g., LF Networking, O-RAN Alliance).

We empower you to be bold and drive your career to create the future you want. We celebrate and reward your achievements. We are seeking an Inside Account Executive (iAE) who will be in charge of achieving quarterly and annual goals by a designated account set of end customers in Brazil. They will build direct relationships with main end customers and create a coverage territory plan with Cisco channel partners to develop opportunities in the assigned territory.

Meet the Team

Global Virtual Sales is on a journey of Transformation. This journey will result in a Transformation of the experience for our customers, partners, stakeholders, and employees, driving higher relevance and stronger business results for Cisco. Two of Cisco’s top priorities are focusing on growth in the Commercial market globally; and with emerging, fast-growing countries worldwide. Our Global Virtual Sales organization, which brings to bear virtual technology and tools to grow revenue and establish relationships with customers and partners, is growing our sales coverage globally to help accelerate these areas of the business, as well as other market segments.

Your Impact

  • Owns end-customer relationships, carries legal quota, and is responsible for the growth of a fixed set of named accounts.
  • Develop/Seek opportunities through sales & marketing activities to final customers and with partners to drive technology penetration in your account list.

  • Collaborate with aligned sales roles to close the deals once an opportunity is identified.
  • Will be responsible for forecasting accuracy and updating salesforce.com and MEDDPICC for deal qualification.
  • Uses new technologies and social selling practices to improve the customer and partner's experience and accelerate Cisco's business including Cisco AI Sales tools.
  • Develops territory plans and campaigns towards selected market opportunities to cover the assigned territory.
  • Prioritizes internal and external resources & implements to meet or exceed sales quota.
  • Will bring new ideas to the sales teams for building new business and crafting additional pipelines.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2-3 years of channel experience or similar business-to-business quota-carrying sales. Software (sales, adoption/renewal) or cyber security experience desired.
  • Cisco sales, product & technical certifications preferred.
  • Consistent achievement of sales quotas.

Preferred Qualifications

BS/BA or equivalent

Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada

When available, the salary range posted for this position reflects the projected hiring range for new hire, full-time salaries in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including equity or benefits. For non-sales roles the hiring ranges reflect base salary only; employees are also eligible to receive annual bonuses. Hiring ranges for sales positions include base and incentive compensation target. Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location and additional factors, including but not limited to skillset, experience, and relevant education, certifications, or training. Applicants may not be eligible for the full salary range based on their U.S. or Canada hiring location. The recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees have access to quality medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, short and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance and numerous wellbeing offerings.

Employees receive up to twelve paid holidays per calendar year, which includes one floating holiday (for non-exempt employees), plus a day off for their birthday. Non-Exempt new hires accrue up to 16 days of vacation time off each year, at a rate of 4.92 hours per pay period. Exempt new hires participate in Cisco’s flexible Vacation Time Off policy, which does not place a defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use, but is subject to availability and some business limitations. All new hires are eligible for Sick Time Off subject to Cisco’s Sick Time Off Policy and will have eighty (80) hours of sick time off provided on their hire date and on January 1st of each year thereafter. Up to 80 hours of unused sick time will be carried forward from one calendar year to the next such that the maximum number of sick time hours an employee may have available is 160 hours. Employees in Illinois have a unique time off program designed specifically with local requirements in mind. All employees also have access to paid time away to deal with critical or emergency issues. We offer additional paid time to volunteer and give back to the community.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

.75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

You’ll gain deep hands-on experience across the entire landing page lifecycle while helping execute and grow one of our most impactful service lines.

Content & QA Support

  • Draft or refine landing page copy tailored to target personas, offers, and funnel stage
  • Review landing pages for accuracy, responsiveness, and proper integration with forms, calendars, pixels, and CRMs
  • Work with developers and creative teams to ensure pages meet quality standards prior to launch
  • Work alongside the Managing Director to operationalize best practices and document repeatable workflows
  • Help maintain and improve internal tools such as audit templates, performance trackers, and testing roadmaps
  • Contribute to ongoing training and resource development for internal teams and freelancers
  • Proactively identify areas for improvement across design, process, messaging, or reporting

  • Experience working with Landing Page & CRM platforms: Unbounce, Hubspot, Marketo, etc

  • Conversion rate performance vs. benchmark or prior page
  • Number of launched landing pages per month
  • Client satisfaction and internal team feedback

title: Engineering Manager, Data & AI
description:
Overview

Are you a product-focused engineering leader passionate about hiring and scaling high performance teams? Do you consider yourself a skilled and empathic manager? Do you enjoy leading people, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and improving software development practices? Have you mentored, coached and provided a clear framework for growth for your team members? We might have the perfect opportunity for you.

ABOUT US:

ChowNow is one of the leading players in off-premise restaurant technology. As takeout becomes a vital revenue stream for independent restaurants, our platform helps owners focus on what they do best—serving great food—by offering solutions across the entire digital dining experience. From building branded websites and mobile apps, to powering online orders, managing menus, consolidating delivery, and running targeted marketing, we give restaurants the tools to grow on their own terms.

We support over 20,000 restaurants across North America , helping process $1B+ in gross food sales while saving our partners over $700M in third-party commission fees . Through our white-label ordering solutions, a growing demand network (including Google, Yelp, Apple, and Snap), and a diner-friendly marketplace, we empower independent restaurants to own their customer relationships and avoid inflated pricing and fees charged by 3rd party delivery apps like Uber and Doordash.

Founded in 2012, we’ve navigated rapid growth and transformation—from startup roots through the pandemic boom—and are now beginning an exciting new era under our CEO, Kanika Soni . As we evolve with new leadership and cutting-edge tools, we’re deepening our commitment to helping local restaurants thrive in the digital economy.

About the Position

ChowNow’s Engineering Team has built a modern platform to enable restaurants to streamline their online ordering processes and create a strong digital brand. Our “quality product first” approach to engineering contributes to our success and brand recognition. We’ve reached the time when we need to grow and scale our engineering team to meet the demand of the many exciting new products and features on our roadmap.

We’re looking for an experienced software engineering leader to join our growing engineering team. As an Engineering Manager, you will help us launch reliable and stable products and support new initiatives to continuously improve the experience of our users. You will shape the product, the software architecture, the development process, and the culture.

Most importantly, you will motivate, encourage and lead your team to success, by finding growth opportunities, providing constructive feedback, and combining challenge and support to get the best out of your colleagues. You will be vital in fostering an engineering culture based on collaboration, inclusion, support, measuring and tracking results, and constant improvement.

This position will lead a team of data and AI/ML engineers who are focused on building the systems that will fuel our product led growth strategies. Your team will directly influence new features while simultaneously tackling engineering-driven initiatives to support our efforts to scale.

This role reports to the Chief Technology & Product Officer. Manages a team of 3-4 engineers.

This is a remote role based in the United States. Please note: ChowNow is not eligible to employ in every state and the recruiting team will confirm location and eligibility before moving past initial stages.

What We Love About You

You put restaurants first. You deeply understand the importance of local restaurants and put them at the center of everything you do. You aim to help them not only survive but thrive.

You celebrate diversity. You recognize that diversity and inclusivity matter. You’re committed to progress, which means everyone gets the support and resources they need, no matter who they are. You have an ability to listen to other team members\' ideas and can thrive in an environment that embraces individuality. Everyone’s voice counts.

You raise your hand. You consistently go above and beyond what is asked of you. You help your peers accomplish their tasks while also excelling at accomplishing your own. When you have a smart idea, you raise your hand and share it.

You keep reaching. You set clear ambitious goals. You don’t allow yourself to become complacent with where you’re at and what you’ve done, so you seek out new opportunities and challenges.

What Success Looks Like

Within 30 Days You’ll:

  • Complete our ChowNow onboarding (Ramp Camp) where you’ll learn the ins and outs about ChowNow and our products.
  • Get to know people - your direct team of data engineering, data analytics and AI/ML engineers, as well as the rest of the Engineering organization, Product, and Design.
  • Join team stand-ups, sprint planning, grooming, and more in order to get familiar with the overall product and team processes.
  • Familiarize yourself with the end to end development process and SDLC.
  • Spend deep dive time with the team to learn more about the core products and how they all fit together.
  • Through 1:1s and team sessions, start to understand your team members’ areas of strength and opportunity, in order to be able to provide career guidance and performance reviews.
  • Understand how business goals and compliance affect our internal processes.

Within 60 Days You’ll:

  • Understand our end to end data and ML stack
  • Drive team towards regular cadence of building and release data and ML products at scale
  • Coach your team on building and delivering new data & ML features and capabilities natively in our customer-facing applications
  • Develop strong relationships with Engineering Leadership and Product peers.
  • Review product requirements and design documents, perform code reviews and weigh in on implementation choices.

Within 90 Days You’ll:

  • Collaborate on defining high-level technology roadmap addressing tech debt, product roadmap, and other needs.
  • Provide on-going constructive feedback and guidance to your team members and as part of performance reviews.
  • Support and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent application of engineering practices.
  • Lead evolution of software development process and practices specially for Data & ML domains while supporting growth of the team and new product initiatives.

You Should Apply If You

  • You have 10+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years focused on data and ML systems, including 3+ years managing high-performing engineering teams of 5-12 direct reports
  • You have successfully managed teams that built data pipelines and ML-powered products such as recommendation engines, personalization systems, or agentic workflows
  • You have strong knowledge of modern data engineering stack including real-time data processing (Kafka, Spark), data quality monitoring, ETL/ELT pipelines, Snowflake, dbt
  • You have working knowledge of Python, and TensorFlow or PyTorch
  • You have thorough understanding of ML model deployment including CI/CD pipelines, A/B testing frameworks, feature stores, and automated ML pipelines
  • You have hands-on AWS experience with ML services (SageMaker, EMR, Redshift) or GCP equivalent
  • You are passionate about Observability, ML model monitoring, drift detection, and performance optimization at scale
  • Experience with LLMs, RAG systems, vector databases, and transformer architectures is a nice to have
  • You have a passion for team building and a track record of recruiting, onboarding and fostering high-performing engineering teams.
  • You care about the quality of work your team produces.
  • You are a fan of rapid iteration and experimentation. You think about failures as a learning opportunity.
  • You are a thoughtful mentor and leader who loves supporting your team and collaborating with others to achieve great things.
  • You thrive in environments supporting your growth, and where you can support others.
  • You are passionate with a contagious energy, encouraging those around you to pursue their goals.

About Our Benefits

  • Expected Base Salary Range: $201,875 - $262,500 depending on candidate location
  • Ongoing training and growth opportunities.
  • A "Best Place to Work" winner multiple times where we focus on creating a great employee experience.
  • Rock solid medical, dental, and vision plans.
  • Mental Health Coverage - we offer several programs to support your mental health and wellness goals.
  • Unlimited Paid Vacation. We expect you to work hard, but still enjoy your personal life
  • 7 weeks of baby bonding time for all new parents (within the first year of birth or adoption), 8 Weeks of Paid Pregnancy Leave.
  • 401(k) Matching
  • Employer-contributing student loan assistance program or continuing education reimbursement program
  • Commuter benefits (including Uber Pool).
  • Employee Stock Incentive Plan.
  • Pet insurance for your fur babies
  • Consistent & fair leadership: we’ll share info, set clear goals, show you respect, and treat everyone fairly.
  • Enough freedom to spread your wings while still holding you accountable.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required.

title: Chemistry Specialist
description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company.

With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI.

Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

We're poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

Role Overview

At Innodata, we're working with the world's largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We're looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Chemistry Subject Matter Expert (SME) to contribute to the development and training of AI Large Language Models (LLMs).

As a Chemistry SME, you will play a critical role in guiding AI models to understand complex chemistry concepts, ensuring accuracy, relevance, and contextual understanding in the domain.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with AI researchers, data scientists, and engineers to train, refine, and evaluate Large Language Models with a focus on Chemistry content.
  • Develop high-quality, accurate, and domain-specific datasets, including conceptual explanations, technical documents, research abstracts, and problem-solving content.
  • Review and validate AI-generated content for technical accuracy, clarity, and contextual relevance in the field of Chemistry.
  • Provide expert feedback on model outputs, identify conceptual gaps, and suggest improvements to enhance model learning.
  • Assist in creating and annotating training datasets, including classification, tagging, and contextual labeling of chemistry-related data.
  • Ensure all content meets scientific rigor and is aligned with industry best practices.
  • Stay up to date with the latest advancements in Chemistry and AI to continuously improve training methodologies.

Key Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related scientific field.
  • Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of chemistry concepts (Organic, Inorganic, Physical, Analytical, Biochemistry, etc.).
  • Prior experience in academic research, technical writing, or teaching is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with data annotation, content development, or training AI models is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Detail-oriented with a passion for accuracy and scientific precision.
  • Technical Skills (Preferred): Familiarity with AI, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs); experience using annotation tools or content management platforms; basic knowledge of Python or data handling tools (preferred but not mandatory).
  • Understanding of data quality control processes.

Assessment

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Dairy Innovation Lead (Open to Remote)
description:
Overview

Cargill’s size and scale allows us to make a positive impact in the world. Our purpose is to nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way. Cargill is a family company providing food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and industrial products that are vital for living. We connect farmers with markets so they can prosper. We connect customers with ingredients so they can make meals people love. And we connect families with daily essentials — from eggs to edible oils, salt to skincare, feed to alternative fuel. Our 160,000 colleagues, operating in 70 countries, make essential products that touch billions of lives each day. Join us and reach your higher purpose at Cargill. This position is in Cargill’s animal nutrition and health business, where we improve animal lives through better nutrition. Our team researches, innovates and creates solutions that deliver healthy results for our customers.

Job Purpose and Impact

The Dairy Innovation Lead (Open to Remote) will lead the vision of, and champion the product innovation pipeline and commercialization of customer solutions with technical, marketing and commercial leaders within the dairy nutrition and management space. In this role, you will identify and execute business innovation growth projects while leading, prioritizing and reporting on the innovation portfolio. You will provide industry-leading expertise to drive process improvements, and deploy the tools and metrics needed to support them while coaching and executing business innovation strategies.

Key Accountabilities

  • Partner collaboratively with relevant stakeholders to build an innovation pipeline aligned with business growth strategies and industry trends.
  • Design and lead innovation projects and independently execute development work, ensuring projects are appropriately resourced and executed.
  • Collaborate with global strategic marketing and technology, research and development and in-market dairy sales and marketing leaders to identify on-farm customer needs to develop new and existing products and solutions.
  • Provide expert thought leadership in the dairy feed and management space, using additional research and interpretation to identify issues or problems.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders and partners across the technical, marketing, commercial, and Innovation teams to drive dairy strategic initiatives.
  • Compile and analyze data for project updates to quantify success and drive accountability. Report on innovation earnings, support business case development, and deliver and manage innovation project technical expenses.
  • Ensure a safe working environment and compliance of animal welfare and product safety.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a field related to animal nutrition or animal science
  • Minimum requirement of six years of relevant work experience
  • Industry experience in dairy, feed, animal nutrition, or agriculture
  • Practical experience in basic animal nutrition, physiology and health expertise
  • Ability to travel up to 25%

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in a field related to animal nutrition or animal science
  • Research skills
  • Experience in digital, automation and/or artificial intelligence
  • Customer-facing technical service experience
  • Project management experience
  • Experience leading non-core innovation originating from customer discovery

Applicant Information

The expected salary for this position is $130,000 to 180,000. Compensation varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific location, certifications, education, and level of experience. The disclosed range estimate may be adjusted for any applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. This position is eligible for a discretionary incentive award. The incentive award amount is dependent upon company performance and your personal performance.

At Cargill we put people first. As part of your overall rewards, we offer a comprehensive benefit program including medical and/or other benefits dependent on the position offered and hours worked. Learn more at: (subject to certain collective bargaining agreements for Union positions).

Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Vet.

title: Video Editor For Science & Paleontology Youtube Channel
description:
Overview

I'm looking for a video editor who specializes in long-form content. This would be a full-time position to edit videos for a YouTube channel that specializes in educational content (think TierZoo). We need someone who is proficient in editing, able to do simple to moderately complex graphics / animations, and able to adapt their style to match our video’s style.

If paleontology and science in general are personal interests of yours, then this role will be perfect for you.

Responsibilities

The process of the job is that we provide you with a script and audio that matches the script, and then it will be your role to find supporting images, videos, and create short motion graphics when applicable. The videos and images will be sourced from studies, documentaries, Wikipedia / Wikimedia, art websites (DeviantArt, ArtStation, etc.), and studies, so being able to Google proficiently is very important. Our video upload schedule is around 1 long-form video a week (between 20–30 minutes in length).

Qualifications

  • Experienced video editor (experience with motion graphics and simple 2D animations)
  • Highly proficient in English
  • Proficient in research
  • Fast and diligent learner, always looking to improve and willing to take the time to understand things like scientific concepts in order to best add value to the video
  • Organized and punctual with delivery
  • Able to learn from feedback (I do not want to provide the same feedback every time without change)
  • Not afraid to ask questions
  • Comfortable using whichever professional video editing tools you prefer

Growth & Compensation

This is a position that can grow as the channel(s) grow over time, meaning that this job can evolve and change. Compensation is per minute edited, with the number depending on time and proficiency.

How to Apply

To apply, please reach out and maybe send me the 1 video you’re most proud of that best shows your applicable talents.

Additionally, please answer these few questions in your reach-out:

  • Where are you from?
  • How many hours a week can you commit to this?
  • What was your last video editing experience?
